2026-10-03.q: Who was the founder of the Asaf Jahi dynasty in Hyderabad Deccan?
2026-10-03.why: Nizam-ul-Mulk founded the Asaf Jahi dynasty in 1724 after defeating Mubariz Khan at the Battle of Shakar Kheda.

2026-10-03.q: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution was the state of Telangana formed in 2014?
2026-10-03.why: Article 3 empowers Parliament to form new States and alter areas, boundaries, or names of existing States by law.

2026-10-03.q: The iconic Telangana Martyrs Memorial (Amaraveerula Stupa) located at Gun Park, Hyderabad was sculpted by which renowned artist?
2026-10-03.why: Prof. Aekka Yadagiri Rao sculpted the historic Gun Park Martyrs Memorial in memory of martyrs of the 1969 Telangana agitation.

2026-10-03.q: Which is the first barrage of the Kaleshwaram Lift Irrigation Project located at the confluence of the Godavari and Pranahita rivers?
2026-10-03.why: Medigadda (Lakshmi) Barrage is the headworks where water is pumped from the Pranahita-Godavari confluence.

2026-10-03.q: The Polavaram Multi-Purpose National Irrigation Project is being constructed across which river in Andhra Pradesh?
2026-10-03.why: Polavaram Project is built across the Godavari River in Eluru and Alluri Sitharama Raju districts of AP.

2026-10-03.q: Under which section of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 does the Governor have special responsibilities for Hyderabad as the common capital?
2026-10-03.why: Section 8 of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 vests special responsibility in the Governor for law and order in the common capital.

2026-10-03.q: According to the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009, what is the pupil-teacher ratio for primary schools (classes 1 to 5)?
2026-10-03.why: The RTE Act norms specify a Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) of 30:1 for primary schools up to 200 enrolled students.

2026-10-03.q: A train 240 m long crosses a telegraph pole in 12 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
2026-10-03.why: Speed = Distance / Time = 240 m / 12 s = 20 m/s. In km/h: 20 * (18 / 5) = 72 km/h.

2026-10-03.q: In a certain code language, if 'PAPER' is written as 'QBQFS', how is 'OFFICE' written in that code?
2026-10-03.why: Each letter is shifted forward by +1: O->P, F->G, F->G, I->J, C->D, E->F.

2026-10-03.q: A sum of money invested at compound interest amounts to Rs. 4,840 in 2 years and Rs. 5,324 in 3 years. Find the annual rate of interest.
2026-10-03.why: Interest for the 3rd year = Rs. 5324 - 4840 = Rs. 484. Rate = (484 / 4840) * 100 = 10% per annum.

2026-10-03.q: Which prominent Indus Valley Civilization site features the world's earliest known tidal dockyard?
2026-10-03.why: Lothal in Gujarat had a sophisticated tidal dockyard connected to the Sabarmati river basin for maritime trade.

2026-10-03.q: Which key policy interest rate is adjusted by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to inject short-term liquidity into commercial banks?
2026-10-03.why: Repo Rate is the interest rate at which RBI lends short-term liquidity to commercial banks against government securities.

2026-10-03.q: What is the maximum deposit insurance coverage provided by DICGC per depositor per insured bank in India?
2026-10-03.why: The Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC) insures bank deposits up to Rs. 5 Lakhs (principal + interest).

2026-10-03.q: In the Union Budget of India, how is the 'Primary Deficit' calculated?
2026-10-03.why: Primary Deficit = Fiscal Deficit - Interest Payments. It indicates government borrowing requirements excluding past interest obligations.

Navyug Express (Mangaluru to Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Katra)

2026-10-03.q: What propellants are utilized in the indigenous CE-20 Cryogenic Upper Stage of ISRO's LVM3 (Launch Vehicle Mark-3)?
2026-10-03.why: CE-20 operates on a gas-generator cycle burning cryogenic Liquid Hydrogen (fuel at -253C) and Liquid Oxygen (oxidizer at -183C).

2026-10-03.q: What is the SI unit of electrical resistance in the International System of Units?
2026-10-03.why: The SI unit of electrical resistance is the Ohm (represented by Greek letter Omega), named after Georg Simon Ohm.

2026-10-03.q: Under which Article of the Constitution can a citizen approach the Supreme Court directly for the enforcement of Fundamental Rights?
2026-10-03.why: Article 32 confers the Right to Constitutional Remedies, famously described by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar as the 'heart and soul of the Constitution'.

2026-10-03.q: Which Constitutional Amendment Act introduced the nationwide Goods and Services Tax (GST) in India?
2026-10-03.why: The 101st Constitutional Amendment Act, 2016 introduced the unified Goods and Services Tax (GST) nationwide effective 1 July 2017.

2026-10-03.q: What is the chemical name of Vitamin C, a water-soluble antioxidant vitamin that helps prevent scurvy?
2026-10-03.why: Vitamin C is chemically known as Ascorbic Acid; deficiency causes scurvy with bleeding gums and slow wound healing.
